scope_notes: Registry of public authorities, institutional contact pathways and government role lookups; no implied endorsement, coalition membership, legal findings or notification.
All 58 county district attorney offices are represented. Names are CDAA directory listings, not separately verified current incumbents; election transitions and vacancies may affect them.
An institution's presence in a county does not confer jurisdiction over conduct elsewhere. Confirm incident site, legal entity, date and relevant authority; do not send to unrelated offices.
The 2026 California Roster and live official directories are sources for statewide elected offices. Lookup rows do not certify a named person or usable distinct contact.
No personal addresses, individual clinician emails, private legal contact lists, message-board targeting or automatic dispatch. Coalition participation must be voluntary.
Private records, evidence, responses and receipt details belong in protected channels; only publish public/redacted material with authorization. No changes to status.md without actual dispatch.
This is not a complete list of all civil-rights practitioners, all affiliate sites, all deputy prosecutors, or 1,000 verified named individuals.
